integrity: The general criterion is an exact algebraic equivalence reconstructed directly from the two equilibrium equations.
The counterexample and branch-sign identity are replayed with exact rational arithmetic by the bundled verifier.
Literature comparison distinguishes the literal theorem correction from the antecedent dryland model and from unrelated Klausmeier results.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects equilibrium feasibility over the source stated parameter domain; it does not assert failure of later results that add c>=0 or otherwise restrict to feasible equilibria.
The exact counterexample is structural and is not claimed to be an ecologically calibrated parameter set.
No stability or nonlinear spatial-pattern conclusion is inferred from the counterexample.
title: A missing positivity filter in the dryland plant equilibrium classification
